host_memory.scope: Origin and terminal memory reads occur inside the measured loop; periodic reads target 100ms QPC cadence. Soft ceiling applies to observed current private commitment; the native job ceiling covers allocations between samples. Lifetime peaks can include initialization. Cleanup memory is separate; job membership is not detached.
